context: Evaluates whether the agent files a genuine, well-formed tech-debt row: correct due diligence, correct next-#, self-contained description, correct enum values, and validation.

checklist.name: Due diligence stated
checklist.description: Agent confirms this is genuinely cleanup, not risk/shortcut/decision, before filing

checklist.name: Correct next #
checklist.description: New row uses last row's # + 1, not an arbitrary or reused number

checklist.name: Self-contained description
checklist.description: Names the file, the unused import, and why the existing gate (warning not error) missed it

checklist.name: Correct Area
checklist.description: Area: Code quality from the current taxonomy

checklist.name: Correct Effort
checklist.description: Effort: S for a one-line deletion

checklist.name: Correct Status/Since
checklist.description: Status: Open, Since is today's date in YYYY-MM-DD

checklist.name: Validation run
checklist.description: validate-tech-debt-schema.sh run or its command shown before declaring done

checklist.name: No append-only ceremony
checklist.description: Does not add a Resolved status or append-only guard for this row

checklist.name: Filed in the right doc
checklist.description: Row filed in docs/TECH_DEBT.md, not RISK_REGISTER.md or skipped entirely
